analyst_observations: with_skill consistently achieves 100% assertion pass rate across all 3 evals
The KB search is the highest-value feature: in all 3 cases, exact matches existed and provided verified fixes with commit hashes
Epic query adds authoritative confirmation but rarely provides new information beyond what KB already contains
without_skill struggles most with fix precision — correct general direction but unable to confirm which specific fix is correct
Time/token tradeoff is significant: with_skill takes ~60% longer but eliminates diagnostic uncertainty
The download_log assertion failure in eval-1 baseline is an environment artifact (agent networking), not a skill quality difference
Non-discriminating assertions: parse_url and no_code_modification pass for both configurations — they test basic capability, not skill value
